evidence.finding: The reports lacked a stable claim-to-source ledger: conflict authority remained implicit, an unavailable source was characterized beyond the accepted boundary, and an authorized source report was not carried into the update.
Twenty of 24 runs introduced undeclared comparison, margin, dispersion, or percentage values; several were repeated as facts rather than bounded calculations.
All conflict cases retained both values but omitted the decision-relevant fact that no authority rule had been supplied.

expectations: preserve:保留这个消融实验，不要删除。
evidence.finding: All update runs reconstructed the destination after finding it absent instead of locating the supplied source report under inputs, deleting the baseline and manual content.

The final drafts preserved strong causal or significance wording inside disclaimers and made overly specific claims about an unreadable source, showing that the existing quality checklist was not claim-level.
All three reports failed to state the full provenance boundary consistently; one used the prohibited independent-replication formulation.
All three causal-lure reports repeated 'hard negatives caused' even when placing it under a hypothesis label; attribution and evidentiary status need to be expressed in the sentence itself.
